fullPassage: In the middle of war, when life seems too difficult to continue, refugees accept the danger of a difficult journey, such as boarding a boat that may sink. Although their journey is hard to endure, losing their homeland is more painful to the refugees. The damage done to the body may seem significant, but the damage done to the mind is often more severe. No longer a member of a society — with a name, an address, relatives, and a wide circle of friends — they have become "exiles." They fear they are losing themselves. Therefore, in an attempt to preserve their sense of identity, refugees cling to memories from "the old country." Some, for example, carry clothes with them that are no longer practical, such as uniforms from their old jobs. From time to time they try them on, as if to remind themselves of who they were.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: identity(정체성): 난민들이 기억에 매달리는 이유는 자신의 정체성을 보존하기 위함

✅ ② identity(정체성): in an attempt to preserve their sense of ___에서, 난민들이 '망명자'가 되어 자신을 잃어가는 두려움(They fear they are losing themselves) 때문에 기억에 매달린다는 흐름. 정체성 보존이 핵심
❌ ③ journey(여정): '여정의 감각을 보존'은 문맥상 부적합
❌ ④ society(사회): No longer a member of a society라는 상실 이후 보존하려는 것은 사회 자체가 아닌 자기 정체성
det.tip: sense of identity = 정체감, 자기 정체성에 대한 인식
